data.exact_reserve_text: The estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred for the 2018 underwriting year increased from GBP 3,338k at 31 December 2019 to GBP 4,597k at 31 December 2020.

named_events.loss_description: mainly attributable to the SPA's exposure to losses arising from Covid-19 within the contingency book of business.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 1.259 million for the 2018 underwriting year, as calculated from the claims development triangle. The overall loss for the financial year was mainly attributed to COVID-19 losses within the contingency book of business.
raw_causal_phrases: losses arising from Covid-19 within the contingency book of business

The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience. This includes assumptions in respect of average claim costs, claim handling costs, claim inflation factors and claim numbers for each underwriting year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from gross claims development triangle for 2018 underwriting year only, as per exclusion rule for the two most recent underwriting years. No specific event named for 2018 strengthening. COVID-19 mentioned as main cause of overall financial year loss, not explicitly for prior year development.
